best_match.fbbt_definition: Any adult neuron that is capable of some detection of stimulus that is part of sensory perception.

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00005124 'sensory neuron', a current FBbt cell term. FBbt has the adult-specific variant FBbt:00058244 'adult sensory neuron', which denotes the same cells in the adult; the data are from adult flies, so the adult term is used.
